subject: TOTAL
text: BTech degree requires a minimum of 240 credits in the legacy scheme (batches admitted up to 2022-23-W)
source_ref: Part A General structure of BTech; S2 section 20

subject: IC
text: Legacy scheme: at least 60 credits from Institute Core (IC) courses
source_ref: Part A General structure of BTech

subject: PC
text: Legacy scheme: at least 60 credits from Professional Core (PC) courses
source_ref: Part A General structure of BTech

subject: DE
text: Legacy scheme: at least 60 credits from Departmental Elective (DE) courses
source_ref: Part A General structure of BTech

subject: OE
text: Legacy scheme: at least 30 credits from Open Elective (OE) courses
source_ref: Part A General structure of BTech

subject: CALA
text: Legacy scheme: at least 30 credits from Creative Arts and Liberal Arts (CA/LA) courses
source_ref: Part A General structure of BTech

subject: TOTAL
text: Current scheme (UG Manual): BTech requires 144 credits plus 12 non-graded core units

subject: CATEGORY
text: Current scheme: Institute core 40.5; program linked 3 to 7; program core 46.5 to 57.5; program elective 21 to 25; open elective 15; liberal arts 10; non-graded core 12 units

subject: SEMESTER
text: Legacy scheme: normal load is 30 credits in each regular semester

subject: SEMESTER
text: Current scheme: from the third semester DUGC convener may allow 15 to 21 credits case by case (upper limit 21)

subject: SEMESTER
text: Current scheme: in the eighth semester a student may register for a minimum of 9 credits if credit requirements are fulfilled

subject: SUMMER
text: Students registering for Summer semester courses may not register for more than 15 credits

subject: ADD_DROP
text: Current scheme: add or drop courses within 5 working days of the start of a regular semester with DUGC convener approval

subject: ADD_DROP
text: Legacy scheme: add or drop within one week from the start of a regular semester; needs instructor acceptance and DUGC approval; drops that cause underloading are not allowed

subject: PRE_REGISTRATION
text: All students must pre-register for next-semester courses as per the academic calendar and must ensure eligibility prerequisites and no timetable clashes

subject: F_GRADE
text: A student who obtained an F grade in a specified prerequisite is not eligible to register for the dependent course
source_ref: Part A Course pre-requisites; S1 section 2.2.5

subject: CLEARED_FIRST
text: Prerequisites are defined only in terms of course codes and a precedent course must be cleared before the dependent course is taken unless concurrent registration is explicitly allowed

subject: OVERLAP
text: A student may not earn credit for a course with more than 25 percent overlap with an approved course already credited

subject: MOOC_CAP
text: A BTech student may credit at most 6 credits from MOOC/NPTEL grade-based courses in the whole programme under Open Elective or Program Elective

subject: MOOC_PROCEDURE
text: MOOC credit needs prior DUGC convener permission; a 14-week or 42-hour course counts as 3 credits; course code uses 495 (e.g. CSL495); the DUGC convener grades it and the grade counts towards CGPA

subject: V_COURSES
text: V-type courses (special-topic or NPTEL lectures) run at least 1 month and BTech students can take at most 6 credits of them in the entire programme

subject: AUDIT
text: A student may audit up to 3 credits per semester with instructor consent; audit grades are not counted in SGPA or CGPA but a pass grade is needed to complete the audit

subject: GRADE_POINTS
text: Grade points: A+ 10; A 10; A- 9; B 8; B- 7; C 6; C- 5; D 4; F 0; FS 0; I 0

subject: PASS
text: A course is passed when the grade is not F or FS or I (or X for non-graded courses)

subject: DEGREE_CGPA
text: A candidate is eligible for the BTech degree only if CGPA is at least 4.5 and the minimum credits are fulfilled

subject: PROBATION
text: If SGPA falls below 4.5 the student is on academic probation and may register for the next semester only if CGPA is at least 4.0

subject: TERMINATION
text: Programme is terminated if CGPA falls below 4.0 or stays below 4.5 for three consecutive semesters

subject: FIRST_CLASS
text: For employment purposes a CGPA of 6 and above is taken as First Class and CGPA is notionally converted to percentage by multiplying by 10

subject: GRADE_IMPROVEMENT
text: Grade improvement is allowed for at most three courses where the grade was C or lower and CGPA is 5 or less; the last grade counts

subject: CREDIT_VALIDITY
text: Earned credits are valid for seven years and expired credits must be earned again
source_ref: section 2.3.1; S2 Repetition of a Course

subject: CURRENT
text: Current scheme: change of discipline may be requested at the end of the second semester through DOAA based purely on CGPA; JEE-admitted students only; no further change after allotment

subject: LEGACY
text: Legacy scheme: change of discipline may be requested at the end of the first semester based on SGPA and Monsoon grades of first year; no further change after allotment

subject: CAPACITY
text: Branch change must not reduce a discipline's enrolment by more than 20 percent nor take it above 110 percent of its allotted capacity

subject: CURRENT
text: Current scheme: a student can register for BTech Honours (course-based or thesis-based) at the end of the 5th semester depending on academic performance

subject: LEGACY
text: Legacy scheme: BTech Honours needs 264 credits with at least 18 through thesis or courses in another discipline; conversion after two years; nominal load 36 credits after conversion

subject: CONVERSION
text: Conversion from BTech to BTech-MTech (5 years) or BTech-PhD (7 to 8 years) is a privilege subject to academic performance and competent authority recommendation

subject: ATTENDANCE
text: Attendance in all classes is compulsory and absence without sanctioned leave may lead to termination

subject: LEAVE
text: DUGC convener may allow leave of at most 9 continuous days in a semester for genuine cases with documents

subject: EXAM_WEIGHT
text: Mid-semester plus end-semester examinations carry at least 50 percent of total weightage in theory courses

subject: MAKEUP
text: A make-up examination request supported by Institute doctor certification must reach the instructor within two days of the last day of the missed exam period

subject: FIRST_YEAR
text: A first-year student who cannot clear at least 60 percent of registered credits must repeat the entire first year

subject: SUMMER
text: Undergraduate students are encouraged to do industrial training or fieldwork in the summers after the 2nd and 3rd year

subject: EPA_NSS
text: Essential Physical Activity is 1 credit and ungraded for CGPA; NSS or NSO requires at least 120 hours

subject: PG_ELECTIVES
text: 500 and 600 level courses may be opened to 3rd and final year BTech students as elective courses only

subject: LAST_GRADE
text: When a course is repeated the last grade is used in CGPA; a core course with F must be repeated whereas an elective can be replaced with another of the same category

subject: PLAGIARISM
text: Plagiarism is strictly prohibited; penalties range from FS or F in the course to suspension or expulsion
